statusLine.command: input=$(cat); current_dir="$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')"; model_name="$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name')"; cd "$current_dir" 2>/dev/null; git_info=""; if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); [[ "$branch" == "HEAD" ]] && branch="$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)..."; git_status=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); [[ -n "$git_status" ]] && status_indicator=" *" || status_indicator=""; git_info=" $(printf '\033[32m%s\033[0m\033[31m%s\033[0m' "$branch" "$status_indicator")"; fi; display_dir="${current_dir/#$HOME/~}"; printf '\033[36m%s\033[0m%s\n\033[90m→\033[0m %s\n' "$display_dir" "$git_info" "$model_name"
